name: pdf_annotation
description: Annotations on a PDF submission, in the format accepted by the MarkUs POST /add_annotations API.

filename.description: The name of the submitted PDF file being annotated, exactly as it appears in the submission (e.g. 'submission.pdf').

annotation_category_name.description: Optional annotation category; MarkUs creates the category if it does not exist.

content.description: The annotation text shown to the student.

type.description: Optional annotation type; if given, it must be 'PdfAnnotation' for a PDF file.

page.description: The 1-based page number the annotation is on.

x1.description: Left edge of the annotated rectangle, as a fraction of the page width multiplied by 100000.

y1.description: Top edge of the annotated rectangle, as a fraction of the page height multiplied by 100000.

x2.description: Right edge of the annotated rectangle, as a fraction of the page width multiplied by 100000.

y2.description: Bottom edge of the annotated rectangle, as a fraction of the page height multiplied by 100000.
